diff --git a/debian/patches/fix-active-inactive-commands.patch b/debian/patches/fix-active-inactive-commands.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bed30e9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/fix-active-inactive-commands.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+Description: active and inactive commands cannot find any entries except last one
+ [PATCH] Update efibootmgr.c
+ get_entry: return entry if it was found before reaching the end of the list
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/rhboot/efibootmgr/commit/3eac27c5fccf93d2d6e634d6fe2a76d06708ec6e
+Bug: https://github.com/rhboot/efibootmgr/issues/186
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/efibootmgr/+bug/2112632
+Last-Update: 2025-08-26
+---
+This patch header follows DEP-3: http://dep.debian.net/deps/dep3/
+--- a/src/efibootmgr.c
++++ b/src/efibootmgr.c
+@@ -1192,6 +1192,7 @@ get_entry(list_t *entries, uint16_t num)
+ 			entry = NULL;
+ 			continue;
+ 		}
++		return entry;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	return entry;
